name: Isle of Wight
type: island; ceremonial county of England; unitary authority area; administrative county
text: The Isle of Wight ( WYTE) is an island off the south coast of England, separated from the mainland by the Solent strait, and otherwise surrounded by the English Channel. For local government purposes the island is a unitary authority area, and it is also a ceremonial county; it was historically part of Hampshire. Its largest settlement is Ryde, and the administrative centre is Newport.

depictions.name: Isle of Wight
depictions.text: The Isle of Wight (Old English: Isle of Wiht) is a county and the largest and second-most populous island in England. Situated in the English Channel, the island was part of Hamtunscire during the Anglo-Saxon period, governed by the Kingdom of Wessex.
